author: claude
summary: Adds a mobile (<=640px) layout for BoothTool, which had zero responsive/width handling and is now the default mobile experience for ChapterEditor (task 007 routes all mobile traffic to it). The desktop side-by-side body (review-text-view + fixed-width review-annotations-drawer) and the follow-along-panel's inline 260px min-width overflowed horizontally at mobile widths; the body now stacks vertically, the fixed-width panels expand to fill the viewport, and follow-along/annotations buttons get a 44x44pt minimum touch target. Autoplay-on-entry was confirmed still absent (BoothTool/index.tsx explicitly calls playChapter(..., false)) and unchanged.

files.change: Added a `@media (max-width: 640px)` block (matching the ChapterList.css/GlobalQueue.css/book.css breakpoint convention): stacks .review-main__topbar and .review-main__body vertically, overrides the .follow-along-panel/.review-annotations-drawer components' inline fixed widths with `!important` so they fill the narrow viewport instead of causing horizontal scroll, and sets min-height/min-width: 44px on the unclassed <button> elements inside those two panels.
